intended_use: style review; not integrated runtime assets

ground.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL fantasy tactical game ground material STYLE SAMPLE, image 1 of a coordinated ground / tree / cliff set.
Primary request: Create one square high-resolution full-bleed ground texture, a quiet forest clearing of mossy olive grass and subtle earthy soil. This is a material study for a reusable tactical map.
Style/medium: sophisticated semi-realistic hand-painted game environment, fine natural texture, restrained brushwork, rich readable forms, neither photographic nor cartoon, no hard outlines. Shared set aesthetic: cool dark emerald foliage, muted olive grass, warm umber soil, slate-gray rocks; soft warm daylight from upper left and soft cool shade toward lower right. Consistent high-angle near-orthographic bird's-eye view, around 65 degrees above the ground.
Composition/framing: ground fills the entire square edge to edge; flat ground viewed from above with no horizon, no perspective trapezoid, no raised island, no cutaway slab, no vignette. Small irregular interwoven patches of short grass, tiny scattered slate pebbles and subdued earth; low-frequency even detail across the frame, no focal object, no central circular clearing, no large boulders, no trees, no distinct road crossing. Surface should visually suit a repeatable ground material, with comparable color and density at opposite edges, without claiming tested seamlessness.
Lighting: subtle local grass and pebble relief only, no large directional cast shadows or dramatic shafts of light.
Constraints: one material image only, no presentation board, no frames, no labels, no text, no grid, no characters, no UI, no watermark. Opaque background, use the whole canvas.

tree.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL fantasy tactical game independent tree STYLE SAMPLE, image 2 of a coordinated ground / tree / cliff set.
Primary request: One mature dark-green spruce tree as a high-quality standalone game environment sprite. Actual transparent background.
Style/medium: sophisticated semi-realistic hand-painted game environment with fine natural textures and restrained painterly edges. Rich readable three-dimensional foliage, neither photographic nor cartoon. Shared set aesthetic: cool dark emerald foliage (#173D35 / #315849), muted olive moss and warm umber bark; soft warm daylight from upper left and soft cool shade toward lower right. Match a forest ground material of mossy olive grass, subdued earth and tiny slate pebbles.
Camera/projection: high-angle near-orthographic bird's-eye tactical view about 65 degrees above the ground. Look down clearly onto layered irregular spruce boughs; see enough trunk and a small root flare to establish the ground anchor. Avoid a frontal Christmas-tree illustration, avoid a side-view tree silhouette.
Composition/framing: a single entire tree with a naturally irregular dense layered crown, readable distinct masses of needles, varied branch lengths, dark shaded lower branches, weathered brown trunk and small root flare. Center the whole tree with about 8 percent transparent padding, no cropping. Minimal muted root debris attached to the roots only, no patch or slab of ground. Clear separation of the sprite silhouette from its transparent surroundings.
Lighting/mood: diffuse warm highlights on upper-left needle masses, cooler shaded lower-right foliage; a small restrained semitransparent contact shadow close to the root anchor only, no oversized shadow triangle.
Constraints: one isolated tree, real alpha transparency across all surrounding space, no painted checkerboard, no black/white/colored background, no forest scene, no circular grass pedestal, no square ground tile, no characters, no UI, no text, no labels, no frame, no watermark. Preserve fine needle edge alpha.
tree.final_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: tactical-game tree style sample, camera correction.
Input image: the provided isolated spruce is the edit target and source for foliage material, palette and lighting.
Primary request: Re-render this same spruce species from a MUCH STEEPER OVERHEAD CAMERA suited to a bird's-eye tactical map. Change its projection, preserving the rich semi-realistic painterly needle textures, dark emerald color, warm upper-left light and cool lower-right shading.
Required camera: near-orthographic camera looking DOWN from 70-75 degrees above ground, only 15-20 degrees away from straight overhead. The canopy must dominate as a broad almost-round irregular rosette with radial overlapping branches seen from above. The treetop projects close to the center of the canopy, slightly above center. The base of the trunk appears only as a small compressed sliver near the lower canopy edge. Show the top surfaces of most branches. Visually foreshorten the tree's height strongly, as if looking down from a very tall tower.
Do not retain the tall frontal triangular silhouette, prominently exposed vertical trunk, or eye-level Christmas-tree view from the input. Do not simply crop, flatten or distort the original image: redraw the branches correctly in the new overhead camera.
Composition: one whole independent tree, centered in a square canvas, foliage and tiny root anchor fully inside with at least 10 percent clear transparent margin. Remove the broad root/ground mound, keep only minimal root detail if visible from above.
Invariants: same spruce, same detailed dark green needle material and bark, same warm upper-left lighting, semi-realistic game art, real transparent alpha background. No landscape, no ground square, no grass pedestal, no second tree, no text, no labels, no watermark, no painted checkerboard.
tree.edit_source: initial spruce draft generated in this task; revised to a steeper overhead projection

cliff.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL fantasy tactical game independent cliff STYLE SAMPLE, image 3 of a coordinated ground / tree / cliff set.
Primary request: One isolated irregular slate-gray rocky escarpment segment, with a mossy top and clearly readable broken vertical rock face, as a high-quality game environment sprite. Actual transparent background.
Style/medium: sophisticated semi-realistic hand-painted game environment, fine natural stone texture, restrained painterly edges, rich readable three-dimensional forms, neither cartoon nor low-poly. Shared set aesthetic: cool dark emerald forest tones, muted olive moss, warm umber earth, slate-gray stone (#56636A / #89918D); soft warm daylight from upper left and soft cool shade toward lower right. Match a ground material of mossy olive grass, subdued earth and tiny slate pebbles, and richly detailed dark emerald spruce foliage.
Camera/projection: near-orthographic tactical-map bird's-eye camera looking steeply down at 65 degrees above horizontal ground, parallel projection with no horizon. Strongly visible top surface, compressed but readable front rock face. Avoid a landscape painting or low frontal camera.
Subject/details: a single roughly horizontal length of natural cliff ledge, about three times as wide as its drop height; irregular shallow curved upper boundary with sparse moss and short grass, layered weathered rock fractures, cool shaded fissures, small broken stones at the cliff foot. The visible rocky top is narrow, limited to this cliff piece. Natural angular stone masses, no geometric slab or cuboid. The segment can serve as the style source for later straight/corner cliff modules.
Composition/framing: whole cliff segment centered, all ends and attached foot rocks fully visible, 8-12 percent transparent margin on every side, broad horizontal composition. No full island, no surrounding terrain square, no raised miniature diorama, no pedestal, no circular terrain base.
Lighting: coherent warm upper-left highlights, cool lower-right crevice shade, restrained local contact shadows, no large detached painted shadow.
Constraints: one independent rocky cliff sprite, genuine transparent alpha outside the silhouette, no painted checkerboard, no colored or black/white background, no trees, no rivers, no bridge, no characters, no buildings, no UI, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark.
